experience: Collect all three coins, activate the checkpoint, avoid the spike strip, and reach the finish gate.
expectedFirstFrame: Side-view obstacle course with the runner on the left and a coin objective in the HUD.
acceptance: The player can move, sprint, jump, and double-jump.
Each coin disappears once and advances the objective state.
The hazard consumes one life and respawns at the active checkpoint.
The finish refuses completion until all three coins are collected.
R restores lives, coins, checkpoint, timer, and visual objective state.
